title: Trying Delhi's 5 BEST PAV BHAJI | The Urban Guide
description:
Join Gattu & Girisha from The Urban Guide as they set out on the ULTIMATE Delhi Pav Bhaji trail! From buttery pavs to spicy, masaledaar bhaji – we’re digging into the 5 BEST Pav Bhaji joints across the capital city. Get ready for a flavour-packed ride as we visit iconic spots like Gupta Ji Pav Bhaji in Daryaganj, Arjun Pav Bhaji in Model Town, and Dwarka’s very own Pav Bhaji gems – Jhakkas Bombay Pav Bhaji, Fingerlickerz Bombaywala, and Shri Ram Pav Bhaji Corner. Kahan ki Pav Bhaji thi sabse best? Watch the video to find out!

PS: Comments mein batana what is your favourite spot to eat Pav Bhaji!
